caveats: Rates primary from gov.uk: the standard rate rose to 20% on 4 January 2011 (from 17.5%); the 5% reduced and 0% zero rates are current as retrieved 2026-11-13.
individualTaxYear runs 6 April to 5 April, primary from gov.uk ('the current tax year is from 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027').
companyYearEndDefault is 31 March (grade I): it preserves the app's existing GB default, aligned to the UK tax year; Companies House otherwise defaults to the incorporation anniversary.

Lower-bound rows - reduced (2022-01-01), zero (2022-01-01): the `from` date is the earliest a source confirms the rate applied, not necessarily its true start (confirmed applying on 1 January 2022 by the Tax Foundation's January 2022 table of VAT rates (sourced from the Commission's Taxes in Europe Database)).
